entities.summary: Simone Decker (b. 1968-04-09, Esch-sur-Alzette) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Esch-sur-Alzette and Luxembourg. Known in the fields of authors & novelists.
